svg.title: Toolbox
svg.desc: 30 tools in 6 groups. Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, Dart, C++, PHP; Web and mobile: FastAPI, Flask, React, Flutter, Tailwind CSS; Data and analytics: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Power BI, Power Query, Excel; AI and vision: YOLOv26, NumPy, NASA TEMPO, OpenAQ; Embedded and IoT: ESP32, MicroPython, Arduino; Platform and security: Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, AppArmor, Linux.
